mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of periods with declining RSAFS, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent economic downturns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals supply-side constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease > 1% does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decline simultaneously, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent economic downturns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of periods with increasing HOUST, or HOUST increase does not correlate with subsequent economic expansions.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising and real GDP (GDPC1) is above trend, it signals a strong supply-side and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rising and GDPC1 above trend
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of rising INDPRO and above-trend GDPC1 does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.
